objective: Resolve numerical and source-comparison uncertainty in the Rouaix jet before spending the large allocation on aircraft and ground predictions.

data_tools.transfer: rsync of immutable input/checkpoint bundles, verified against hashes; no deletion mirroring by default
data_tools.derived_arrays: HDF5 for compact analysis products if site/toolchain support is confirmed; retain native OpenFOAM restart fields
data_tools.tracking: Weights & Biases for metrics, provenance and artifact paths/hashes; no external upload until project configuration is supplied
data_tools.large_fields: site scratch and durable archive with measured quotas and sparse full snapshots

reference.paper_mesh_and_duration: PDF page 8 / article page 7, section 3.3; localized 70/50/30/16 mm meshes; about 5 s to stabilize penetration and width; exact ROI and statistical window unavailable
reference.baseline_solver: Pinned OpenCFD v2512 with diagnostic interIsoFoamTracePair overlay and normal-head side-pressure implementation; package source and rebuild against compatible cluster MPI
reference.paper_comparison_status: not validated; significant penetration discrepancy and width/observer uncertainties remain

invariants_for_matched_numerical_compari: Exact source polygon, integrated source area, direction, imposed velocity and liquid volume flux
Fluid properties, surface tension, gravity, coordinate frame, turbulence inputs and physical boundaries
Observer definitions, x stations, normalization and physical-time comparison windows
Full diagnostic provenance including the side-pressure implementation
Only the declared numerical factor changes within each comparison

stages.name: environment_and_restart
stages.question: Does the exact intended solver run and restart correctly on the supplied hardware?
requirements: site-supported MPI and native build or compatible Apptainer route
portable custom source overlay with hashes
release_evidence: real advancing solver time on intended nodes
finite bounded fields and converged linear solves
restart ledger with offsets applied exactly once
stages.notes: Thread count one per MPI rank. Do not assume workstation Docker or an x86 binary is portable.

stages.name: scaling_and_io
stages.question: Which rank count gives useful wall-time improvement at acceptable allocated core-hour cost?
stages.window: Same immutable representative wet checkpoint and same physical interval; separate startup/warmup, timed steps and one real checkpoint write
measure: pressure and communication share where instrumented
stages.rank_choice: Choose from measured cost versus completion-time tradeoff using actual node billing; do not assume all 1300 ranks improve one job
stages.stop_rule: Do not double ranks again when the preceding trial shows no useful throughput gain; preserve measurements and choose the cheaper allocation
stages.io: Benchmark default file handler before collated/MPI-IO; sparse full fields and compact numerical observables; verify restart and visualization compatibility before adoption

stages.name: mesh_family_repair
stages.question: Can we construct a comparable refinement family without changing the source or introducing poor transitions?
stages.action: Locate both failure sets, smooth the coarse/fine transitions and correct determinant failures; run the same full geometry/topology checks and integrated source checks again
stages.family: Coarse reference plus intermediate and fine corridor meshes sharing the physical ROI and source footprint; report actual directional sizes, not a single nominal label
stages.fine_target: Approximately 16 mm in every relevant direction in the selected breakup/comparison ROI, with ROI and limits explicitly declared; exact published ROI is unknown
stages.restriction: No solver launch on either preserved failed mesh; no quality-threshold relaxation to rename it valid
release_evidence: source area and oriented flux consistency

stages.name: matched_transport_and_boundary_checks
stages.question: Which remaining changes materially affect the paper observables, rather than merely the image?
stages.first_pair: Completed upwind versus limitedLinearV/PBiCGStab branches at common saved times through 1 s; analyze existing fields before rerunning
conditional_short_pairs: fixed mesh and model with one halved timestep
same source and observation ROI with moved side boundaries if local side influence is measurable
limited turbulence convection or gradient reconstruction only if the field audit identifies a remaining defect
observables: liquid inventory and all boundary fluxes
local velocity, k, epsilon and modeled viscosity near the interface
stages.restriction: Do not combine a mesh, closure, inlet and transport change into one claimed causal comparison; do not fit inlet turbulence to match the paper

stages.name: rouaix_long_horizon_refinement
stages.question: Do stabilized penetration, width and core breakup approach a consistent result as resolution improves?
stages.runs: Start coarse and intermediate matched references toward approximately 5 s; start the fine mesh after its short pilot confirms stable evolution and measured affordability
stages.initial_time: Clean start for each changed mesh/model; a mapped restart requires its own declared transient and must not be called a clean reproduction
stages.sampling: Track time histories and compare multiple late windows. About 5 s is the paper's duration, not proof that our fields have stabilized
stages.timestep_followup: One halved-dt comparison on the most informative affordable mesh; do not conflate its effect with refinement
stages.report: Profiles and bias with digitization/observer uncertainty, grid/time sensitivities and remaining implementation gaps; no automatic E1 pass
stages.cost_release: Forecast total allocated core-hours, per-node peak RAM, output bytes and completion time from the wet pilot before extending each run

stages.name: model_sensitivity_then_aircraft
stages.first_model_pair: Standard k-epsilon versus realizable k-epsilon with unchanged mesh, inlet k/epsilon and numerics, only if diagnosed behavior or source evidence selects this test after numerical uncertainty is characterized
stages.next: Choose a second Rouaix condition already reported in the source to test predictive transfer before a broad aircraft campaign
stages.aircraft: Return to the declared Dash-8 source-history problem and then measured Restas geometry/history; keep paper-input ambiguity separate from solver error
deferred: many long renders on compute nodes
stages.restriction: Nearfield agreement alone does not validate parcels, ground maps, useful-strip scores, foam or the built device

accounting_and_stop_policy.cost_formula_simple_core_billing: allocated CPU count * elapsed wall hours; verify site billing TRES and whole-node policy separately
stop: missing ledger data or unacceptable declared conservation error
forecast exceeds the declared useful-run budget without a new scientific decision
accounting_and_stop_policy.thresholds: Run-specific numerical and physical tolerances must be declared before launch with justification. This planning file creates no formal acceptance thresholds.
accounting_and_stop_policy.full_machine_use: Use spare nodes for independent ready comparisons when this improves time to an answer; no requirement to fill cores with uninformative jobs
